title: microcitrus garrawayae
intro: Microcitrus garrawayae, commonly known as the Desert Lime, is a rare and endangered species of citrus plant native to Australia. The Desert Lime has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to aid in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. Its therapeutic actions include exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal properties, as well as providing a natural source of flavonoids and limonoids, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Microcitrus garrawayae include flavonoids, limonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
